projects.title: Nova AI Design Studio
projects.description: An interactive, collaborative canvas engine with integrated Generative AI tools and instant vector exports.
projects.longDescription: Nova AI is a real-time multiplayer vector editor designed for modern designers. Combining canvas performance with advanced server-side Gemini API generation, users can create layered illustrations, iterate drafts, and export designs instantly.

projects.title: Aether Telemetry Dashboard
projects.description: High-throughput visual analytics and system monitoring dashboard with interactive charts and low-latency rendering.
projects.longDescription: Aether aggregates distributed server logs and active processes, outputting clean, interactive visualization nodes. Features dense custom charts, customizable grid layouts, and lazy-loaded WebGL layouts for heavy datasets.

projects.title: Helix Mobile Commerce
projects.description: An elegant, fluid web e-commerce framework specialized for mobile devices with high-fidelity swipe gestures.
projects.longDescription: Helix is a React Native-inspired mobile web experience that redefines shopping on smaller displays. Crafted with pure native gesture bounds, cached product states, and a highly customizable design layout.

projects.title: Scribe Smart Note System
projects.description: A cloud-native rich text editor feature-packed with semantic categorizations and contextual summary tools.
projects.longDescription: Scribe parses handwritten, voice, or typed documents to dynamically map ideas into mind-map nodes. Uses smart vector embeddings to group concepts and suggest references securely.
